Metadata.title: Vahti AI
Metadata.description: AI receptionist platform for healthcare clinics in Finland.

hero.title: Never miss a patient again.
hero.subtitle: Vahti AI answers every call, message and chat around the clock — in Finnish and English. It qualifies leads, books appointments and keeps your calendar full.

stats.title: What Vahti AI delivered this month

features.title: What we do
features.subtitle: One AI receptionist that handles the whole enquiry, from first contact to booking.
features.voiceDesc: Answers the phone in seconds, speaks natural Finnish and English, and escalates urgent cases to your staff.
features.chatDesc: Handles price questions, FAQs and bookings on WhatsApp, your website chat and Instagram.
features.crmDesc: Scores leads, moves them along the pipeline and triggers follow-ups automatically.
features.multilangDesc: Detects the language automatically and replies in kind — Finnish and English today, Swedish coming.

channels.title: Every channel, one front desk
channels.subtitle: Patients reach out however they like. Vahti AI is there on every channel.
channels.voiceDesc: 24/7 phone line, automatic language detection and near real-time responses.
channels.whatsappDesc: A WhatsApp Business number where prices, questions and booking happen over chat.
channels.webchatDesc: Qualifies website visitors and books appointments right in the chat window.
channels.outboundDesc: Calls a new lead automatically within 60 seconds of their enquiry.

calc.title: How much are missed enquiries costing you?
calc.subtitle: Estimate the revenue you lose when enquiries go unanswered.
calc.conversionLabel: Share that converts to a booking (%)
calc.recovered: This is what Vahti AI could win back.
calc.note: Formula: average × missed / week × 4.33 weeks × conversion %. Indicative only.

steps.title: Live in 5 minutes
steps.subtitle: No code, no lengthy onboarding.
steps.step1Desc: Tell it your clinic's services and prices — or drop them into the knowledge base in a few lines.
steps.step2Desc: Pick channels, languages and workflows. Test the agent before going live.
steps.step3Desc: Connect your phone number and WhatsApp. Vahti AI starts answering right away.

footer.tagline: AI receptionist for healthcare clinics in Finland.
footer.demoNote: Demo — content and figures are examples.

Pricing.title: Straightforward pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Finnish + English, knowledge base and the agent test screen in every plan. No lock-in, billed monthly.
Pricing.faqTeaser: Questions about the plans? See the page for clinics and the FAQ.
Pricing.descEssential: Starter plan for a single clinic: chat and WhatsApp.
Pricing.descProfessional: For a growing clinic: inbound phone answering and automations too.
Pricing.descBusiness: For multiple locations: CRM, outbound calls and integrations.
Pricing.descEnterprise: For chains and special needs: customisation and a dedicated contact.

Workflows.title: Workflows
Workflows.subtitle: Automations — trigger and action
Workflows.engineBody: A node-cron scheduler starts with the server (instrumentation.ts) and runs active workflows on schedule. Without DATABASE_URL the actions are simulated with mock data. Messages go out over WhatsApp once WHATSAPP_TOKEN is set.
